transcript.content: Brontemoor Medical Group, this is Nurse Bronancy. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to get my lab results from last week.
Of course. Before I can share that, I need to verify your identity. Can you please give me your full name and date of birth?
Marcus Delgado, August 22, 1974.

Thank you Marcus. One moment while I pull up your file. I'm so sorry, our lab results portal is offline for maintenance right now. I'm not able to retrieve those values for you. There are a few ways I can help though - I can call you back as soon as the portal's back up tomorrow morning, you can message Dr. Chen through the patient portal, or I can schedule a brief telehealth visit so the doctor can review the results with you once available. Which would you prefer?
Let's do the callback.
Great, I have you down for a callback after 8 AM tomorrow. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Marcus. Take care.
Brontemoor Medical Group, this is Nurse Bronancy. How can I help you today?
I need to refill my lisinopril.
Of course. Can I get your full name and date of birth to verify?
Lillian Park, February 11, 1948.
Thank you Lillian. I see your lisinopril 10mg here. Which pharmacy would you like me to send it to?
CVS on Maple Street, please.
Got it, CVS on Maple. I'm submitting that refill now. It should be ready for pickup after 4 PM today. Is there anything else?
No, thank you so much.
You're welcome, Lillian. Have a great day.
Brontemoor Medical Group, this is Nurse Bronancy. How can I help you today?
I've had a fever and a really bad cough for three days now.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can I get your name and date of birth?
Andrew Vasquez, July 4, 1991.
Thanks Andrew. How would you describe the severity - is it interfering with your daily activities?
Yeah, I can barely sleep.
Given the persistent fever and cough, I'd recommend a same-day in-person visit so the provider can listen to your lungs. I have an opening today at 2:30 PM with Dr. Chen. Would that work?
Yes, that works.
Booked. You'll get a text confirmation. Drink fluids and rest until then.
Brontemoor Medical Group, this is Nurse Bronancy. How can I help you today?
I've been on hold for 40 minutes. My prescription refill hasn't gone through and the pharmacy is saying you never sent it.
I'm really sorry about the wait. I can hear how frustrating this has been. Let me fix it right now. Can I get your name and date of birth?
Karen Mitchell, December 1, 1983.

Thank you Karen. I'm looking at your file - I see the refill request from three days ago. It looks like it didn't transmit. I'm resubmitting it right now to your pharmacy. Confirmation number RX-CONF-99231. You should be able to pick up after 4 PM today. I'll also flag this for our pharmacy liaison so we can figure out what went wrong.
OK, thanks. That's what I needed.
Of course. Sorry again for the trouble - have a good rest of your day.
